incidents.description: The same task entered duplicate phase execution when approval auto-dispatch overlapped with a manual Board dispatch. This created duplicate build-verifier runs and inconsistent operator expectations.
incidents.evidence: During the MarkupSafe reverse-engineering run, build-verifier started twice for the same task after PR approval and a Board dispatch click.
incidents.title: Task could be dispatched twice during integration handoff

incidents.description: Historical validation incident. Verified on 2026-04-26 that the quality-gate pytest lane now disables host plugin autoload and prefers workspace-local src imports. Keep only until a status-mutation surface exists.
incidents.evidence: Resolved in current code: src/autonomous_agent_builder/quality_gates/testing.py sets PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 and injects workspace src into PYTHONPATH.
incidents.title: Quality gate runner inherited hostile host test environment

incidents.description: Historical validation incident. Verified on 2026-04-26 that the documentation refresh gate now validates against project_root, not the isolated task workspace. Keep only until a status-mutation surface exists.
incidents.evidence: Resolved in current code: src/autonomous_agent_builder/orchestrator/orchestrator.py derives project_root from project.repo_url or workspace_path before KB validation and refresh.
incidents.title: Documentation gate validated task workspace instead of project root

incidents.description: Historical validation incident. Verified on 2026-04-26 that the backlog page now receives merged artifact and DB backlog items and treats backlog as a first-class status group. Keep only until a status-mutation surface exists.
incidents.evidence: Resolved in current code: /api/dashboard/features merges artifact and DB items, and frontend/src/pages/BacklogPage.tsx renders backlog status explicitly.

incidents.description: Validation smoke artifact only. Verified on 2026-04-26 that this item was created purely to prove typed incidents render on the backlog page and does not represent follow-up product work.
incidents.evidence: Non-actionable smoke entry retained only because the public backlog surface cannot yet mark items cancelled or done.
incidents.title: Browser smoke typed backlog incident

incidents.description: Historical validation incident for the JSON/React approval path. Verified on 2026-04-26 that the main dashboard approval details endpoint normalizes naive timestamps. A legacy HTMX route still raw-sorts timestamps, so this remains historical rather than a fully deleted concern.
incidents.evidence: Partially resolved in current code: api/routes/dashboard_api.py normalizes timestamps for approval details, while dashboard/routes.py legacy thread rendering still sorts raw timestamps.
incidents.title: Approval page crashed after approval state change

incidents.description: The documentation refresh gate validates project-root system-docs during a forward-engineering task even though generated code lives in a task worktree and the greenfield project has no system-docs yet. The task blocks with non-actionable documentation freshness failure.
incidents.evidence: In /private/tmp/aab-forward-20260426-171559, task 5e633692-c98e-4fbf-8553-872e00b8aae1 blocked at quality_gates: documentation refresh gate blocked: validation failed without actionable stale maintained docs. builder knowledge validate failed: Knowledge base not found at .agent-builder/knowledge/system-docs. builder knowledge extract --force created only partial docs and failed generator validation.
incidents.title: Forward-engineering quality gate blocks greenfield worktree with missing system-docs

incidents.description: After retrying onboarding, the browser showed queued KB phases but both Resume onboarding and Retry failed phases were disabled because actionPending was only cleared when ready=true. Fixed frontend pending cleanup in App.tsx.
incidents.evidence: External clone /tmp/aab-reverse-validate: after retry, repo detect through work item seed passed, KB phases stayed queued, and the snapshot showed Resume onboarding and Retry failed phases disabled. Reload later showed ready state.
incidents.title: Onboarding UI leaves recovery buttons disabled after partial run

incidents.description: The reverse-engineering feature implementation eventually passed target tests, but the Agent run remained live while documentation-agent publishing looped on KB contract and kb_validate safe-lane errors. Runtime should surface this as a blocked documentation closeout instead of leaving the user-facing run live.
incidents.evidence: External clone /tmp/aab-reverse-validate-fresh, session 1ab83b1c-d156-44a1-b623-81a739e00772: target pytest command passed 8 tests, but builder logs then showed mcp__builder__kb_lint contract failures and mcp__builder__kb_validate permission_denied for absolute kb_dir while agent history still reported running=true.
incidents.title: Reverse agent run can stay live after tests pass due KB publish contract errors

incidents.description: Fresh reverse-engineering dashboard onboarding failed before repo scan because Claude Agent SDK startup received env=None and raised 'NoneType' object is not a mapping. Fixed in claude_runtime by passing an empty env mapping.
incidents.evidence: External clone /tmp/aab-reverse-validate: Start onboarding through dashboard produced 'Onboarding disabled: Claude unavailable for KB extraction. backend=sdk. Failed to start Claude Code: NoneType object is not a mapping'. Regression test added in tests/test_claude_runtime.py.
incidents.title: Reverse onboarding SDK env None blocks Claude availability
